_source: Claude-authored DRAFT (2026-07-28) for the carry layer. Lines use a {carry} token filled with the formatted figure. Rewrite freely in the content pass; keep thresholds ascending-ish (the picker takes the highest thresholdM <= carry and rotates among ties). thresholdM is millions USD.

{carry}: a private chef through your next three pivots.
